$comment: Curated presence tiers that replace the computed ones (spec 5.6.5). Each entry needs a citation: source.title, source.url and the exact quote it relies on; an entry without them is loaded as needs_review. Fields: iso3, presence_tier (major_producer | producer | occurrences_known | none_identified | unknown), presence_basis, presence_confidence (high | medium | low), presence_as_of_year, optional asm_present and commercial_mining (true/false, as the source states), source {title, url, source_type, reliability_tier}, quote, checked_on (YYYY-MM-DD). Each quote is re-checked against the source on every run.

overrides.presence_basis: The USGS Minerals Yearbook 2022 chapter on the Indian Ocean Islands states that Comoros "did not produce any minerals".

source.title: U.S. Geological Survey, Minerals Yearbook 2022, volume III: Indian Ocean Islands (Table 1, note 2)

overrides.quote: Although Comoros is a part of the Indian Ocean Islands, it did not produce any minerals and depended upon cement imports to meet domestic demand.

overrides.presence_basis: The USGS reports about 20 t of gold a year for Togo, but says these figures are export data that mostly include artisanal gold transiting Togo from neighbouring countries and, to a lesser extent, domestic artisanal production. Domestic output is not quantified, so Togo is not counted as a major producer.

source.title: U.S. Geological Survey, Minerals Yearbook 2019, volume III: Togo

overrides.quote: Data reported by the Government of Togo as exports predominately include artisanal gold mine production transiting Togo from neighboring countries and, to a lesser extent, domestic artisanal mine production.

overrides.presence_basis: Small, low-grade gold anomalies are documented in the northeast of Guinea-Bissau (Wikipedia, Geology of Guinea-Bissau). No production is reported.
overrides.quote: Some small, low-grade gold anomalies exist in the northeast of Guinea-Bissau.

overrides.presence_basis: The Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime reports artisanal gold mining at Milxo in north-eastern Somalia, which it describes as one of Africa's least-known gold booms. No production figure is published.

source.title: Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime: The Somali gold rush: Milxo and the ungoverned mining frontier (2 February 2026)

overrides.quote: Milxo is a tiny mining settlement in a remote and contested region of north-eastern Somalia that, over the past decade, has become the site of one of Africa’s least-known gold booms.

overrides.presence_basis: The USGS lists kaolin, salt, and sand and aggregate as the minerals that may have been produced in Cabo Verde in 2019; gold is not among them.

source.title: U.S. Geological Survey, Minerals Yearbook 2019, volume III: Other Countries of Africa

overrides.quote: In 2019, kaolin, salt, and sand and aggregate may have been produced in Cabo Verde, but available information was inadequate to make reliable estimates of output
